balls.text: Cleaned up by a lovely slower one. Trivedi had backed away and was baffled by the slower one. He had a waft but no where in line. This is the lowest total by a team batting first.
run out missed. Jayasuriya picked up the steer at backward point and fired in a throw at the striker's end but missed. Trivedi  had run with the stroke but was sent back
full and straight, pushed to the off side
Nehra takes him out with a bouncer. A weak jab and it goes off the gloves and Yogesh, the 'keeper, dives forward to take a sharp catch
length delivery on the middle, defended to the off side
full and angling across, steered through cover point
The stumps are in disarray. It was full, it was straight and Tanvir went across the line but missed it.
on a length, on the middle, pushed down the track and the bowler dives to his right to make the stop
on the middle and leg, turned to fine leg
full and outside off stump, edges his off drive to third man boundary
another slower one, pushed to extra cover for a single
on the middle and leg, tucked to square leg
Done in by the slower one. Lovely one from the back of the hand and Swapnil holes out to long-off. Tendulkar is beaming.
overpitched on the stumps, driven hard but it crashes into the stumps at the other end
on a length, around middle and leg, shapes in, defended to the on side
leans across, opens the bat-face and steers to third man
tries the slower one but it was well outside off stump
fullish, on the off stump line, driven crisply but straight to covers
The pull goes awry. It was short and on the off stump line, Warne made room for himself and went for his pull but skied it up and it came down for the 'keeper to hold it. Can Jaipur get to 150?
change of pace, outside leg, tapped behind square
Charges down the track and drills an intended yorker straight over the bowler's head
slower one but slips down leg side
on a length, on the middle, turned past square leg
just outside off, tries to cut late but misses
unfurls his trademark ugly pull. The face is yanked back, away from the line, but the bat comes through and he hits this one to deep square leg
short and outside off, cut to third man
full delivery, crashed to covers
just outside off stump, cut to backward point
another yorker on the middle, jabbed to the off side
yorker length, on the middle, tapped to right of midwicket

Mumbai prise out another wicket. It was a sharp bouncer and a surprised Jadeja fended it off in an ungainly manner- the ball got big on him and his weak pull was not good enough- and the ball looped behind the 'keeper who took a few steps before diving to his front to take a very good catch
fuller, on the off stump line, driven back to the bowler

Short of length, outside off, Kaif cuts hard but it flies off the outer edge to Nehra at third man. Sachin is happy and is seen applauding from the side lines. Mumbai Indians are doing quite well here tonight.

Dropped by Jayasuriya at backward point. It was a slower one and Swapnil Asnodkar was completely fooled. He checked his drive and it went off the outside edge to left of Jayasuriya who got under it but spilled a dolly
on a length, on the off stump, pushed to deep cover
on a length and Kaif pushes it to midwicket
short of length, on the middle and off, mistimes a pull shot past square leg

loud appeal for lbw but it was going down leg side. Kaif thought it would turn, it didn't and went on with the angle. Hit in front of leg and it would have drifted down leg. Hawk eye suggests it would have clipped the outer half of the leg stump.
leans forward to hit to left of long-off for two runs
flighted full on the stumps, Swapnil Asnodkar opens up his stance and drills it over Jayasuriya's head and down to long-off
slows up the pace, on the middle and off, Kaif steers it to cover point region for a single
low dipping full toss, driven to deep cover
floated on the middle and off stump, pushed to the off side
in the zone outside off stump and Kaif lets it go through to the 'keeper
The round-the-wickets angle has worked.  It was angling across Watson who went for a slog across the line and dragged it to his stumps.

hit on the helmet. It was a sharp bouncer, Swapnil missed to connect with his pull shot - beaten for pace - and it crashed into the side of the helmet and rolled away to backward point region. Perhaps, he nicked it as well but may be not.
goes round the stumps and hurls it full on leg and middle, whipped to deep square leg position
short of length, quicker, on the middle, Swapnil twists his body and manages to work it past square leg. The pair have added 50 runs off 31 balls
change of pace but Swapnil waits before playing the lofted shot to deep extra cover region

Short and outside off, Watson waited before biffing a flat-batted pull past the bowler and to the right of the long-off fielder. It wasn't far away from the man but it was traveling at such pace that he couldn't get across in time
quicker, fuller, flicked past square leg
again he takes out the pace by holding the ball deep inside his palm and Watson punches it to extra cover
slows up the pace, flights it full and outside off, mistimes his cut to cover point
quicker, on the middle stump line, punched to midwicket region
floated outside off and Watson reached out and slog swept it to the cow corner - wide midwicket region
slightly short and Swapnil goes for his pull and miscues it. Abhishek Nayyar runs in from deep midwicket and dives in front but can't reach
full and outside off, Swapnil takes out the left leg outside and thus, gets him too far from the line and attempts a slog and is beaten
fullish, on the middle and leg, Watson tries to flick it over square leg, misses and it runs off the pad
on the leg stump line, tucked behind square leg
High and harmless bouncer. Too high.
short and on the off and middle, Swapnil stays adjacent to the line and tries to cut it past the backward point but finds the fielder
drifts down leg side again, short too, and Swapnil went for a almighty pull but couldn't connect
gets it right this time - on and around that off stump, Watson opens the bat-face and guides it to third man
a wide down the leg side
The white ball has begun to fly. Swapnil took out his left leg from the line of a full delivery and sent the ball soaring over long-on. Kalu would have loved it.
short of length, on the middle stump and Swapnil flat-bats a pull to mid-off
bowls this one outside off and Watson again tries to loft but gets a outside edge, one bounce to third man
short of length this time and it cuts in towards middle and off, Watson pushes it back to the bowler
This one flies over wide mid-on region. Again that guard on off and middle, a slight shuffle from there and lofts the full delivery on the off stump

Picked over midwicket. It was full and on the middle and off but Watson clipped it over midwicket. Watson is standing on a middle and a off guard and that's why he was able to send that ball on the off stump over midwicket.
sharp bouncer and Swapnil is surprised and just about manages to fend it to the off side
lands it a on a length and it comes to the middle and off, Swapnil stays beside the line and punches it to backward point
length delivery outside off stump, defended to covers
another slower one but this one bounces a bit and Swapnil swats it past square leg
slower one, just outside off but Watson waits on the ball before tapping it to third man for a single
full pitched o nthe middle and Watson wrists it through midwicket for couple of runs
shifts his line to the middle stump, Watson clips it past square leg
length delivery outside the off stump and Watson drills it between the bowler and the mid-off fielder
slightly slower in pace, again angled across Watson who has a lame poke and a miss
angles away past the off stump, and Watson edges it to slip. Falls short of Jayasuriya.

The big-hitting Yusuf falls. The swipe across the line has turned fatal. It landed on a length, on the middle stump and shaped towards the off stump. Yusuf Pathan tried to heave it to the leg side and missed. Gone!
Polly tries a slower one but Swapnil picks it up, waits before thumping it over point. The little man is rocking
There goes Kalu. He frees his arms at a length delivery outside off and slices it off the outside edge over short third man. Remember Polly has a short third man and a deep third man for Swapnil
length delivery coming in to the off stump and nudged to cover point
short one and Pathan sways away

Bizarre dismissal. Silly too. Smith had walked into a drive to a length delivery on the leg stump and missed it completely. He was outside the crease as he had over balanced and just kept walking! The ball went to the 'keeper who fumbled it before picking the ball and breaking the stumps. But Smith was not even looking behind. Did he think he was bowled? or did he think he would have been easily stumped? What a dramatic start. Strange dismissal that.
Interesting. This time, Smith moves outside leg stump, with the 'keeper standing up, and punches a length delivery on the off stump to covers
swing and a miss. He attempts a big swipe across the line, misses the ball completely but has a nice smile.
beaten outside off on the drive
Absolutely Kalu like shot. It was full and shaping away a touch, Swapnil just stood there and creamed it through cover point.
again full and outside off, Smith had shuffled but its still outside off and he pushes it to mid-on region for a single.

lands on a length, outside off stump and straightens, Smith defends down the track. This is interesting. Since he is shuffling across the stumps, Nehra has started to bowl outside off. Now will Smith stand at his usual position and crack 'em through off side?
full and straight, Smith waits before rolling his wrists to send the ball through midwicket. A slight shuffle across again.
Goes for the pull, miscues it slightly but it lands beyond the reach of the midwicket fielder
Again that walk across and down the track and once again, he turns a length delivery on the off stump past square leg
leans forward to push a full delivery to mid-on region
on  a length, outside off stump, cut to that short third man who fumbles. Mumbai have done their homework as Swapnil cuts in that region a lot
walks across the stumps and a touch down the track and clips a length delivery on the off stump to square leg
You can guess where it landed. On and around that good length that Pollock pings consistently and around the off stump, Smith defends to the off side
yet another wide. Game over. Mumbai Indians have beaten the in form team of the tournament.
slower one but again drifts down leg side. Uthappa just watched it go past him. The scores are level
slips down leg side. Another wide.
cut to backward point
sweeps him fine for couple of runs.
loopy delivery on the off stump, turning in, played to the off side
wide wide one outside the off stump. He was looking for the slider across the left-hand batsman but the release went completely wrong
slow loopy legbreak, Uthappa leans forward, opens the bat-face and plays to backward point region
charges down and lofts to long -on
drops this one short - yet another one from Warnie tonight, pulled away ferociously to deep midwicket boundary
on the middle and leg, turned wide of mid-on for a single
short of length, on the off stump, defended down the pitch
no surprise - it is a bouncer and Uthappa pulls it to deep square leg
short one, Nayar hops, drops it in front of him and they rush across for a quick single
That slow bouncer again - it arrived ever so late and Uthappa waited and waited before lapping around the corner to fine leg
on a length, around off, punched to mid-off
fuller, turned to midwicket
yet another bouncer - head high- and Robin connects well with his pull shot this time and sends it sailing over  fine leg
bangs in a short one on the off stump, Uthappa, on the front foot, goes for a pull and top edges it high and over the 'keeper's head
length delivery on the off stump line, punched down the track
again a touch short of length, outside off, cut to deep cover
slightly short in length, stops on the batsman, mistimes a cut to point
short and climbing outside off, Uthappa tries to steer it to the third man, rather late decision and he doesn't connect. The 'keeper and the bowler appeal for a catch, Rudi is not interested
It's a full one and defended to cover point
full and straight, driven back to the bowler
Gone this time. Caught at short midwicket. It was a length delivery and Bravo whipped it across to that man stationed for exactly
bangs it short of length, outside off stump, Uthappa defends compactly to the off side
full and just outside off stump, Bravo drives uppishly but luckily, for him, falls just short of short cover
short and wide down the leg side, Uthappa misses a pull and it runs off the pad. That one should have been put away.
flighted legbreak on the off stump, it was not so short but Uthappa went right back, created length and cut it past backward point. T
short and outside off this time, cut to deep extra cover
short and wide down leg side, pulled to fine leg where Yusuf makes a diving stop to prevent the boundary
flighted delivery, Bravo was beaten in the flight and was struck on the pad but it was spinning away from the stumps. Warne let out a roar of an appeal
the slow loopy spinner this time but its down leg side

A ripper of a flipper!  It landed short of length, on the middle and off stump line, Takawale goes for the pull shot - better batsmen than him have been fooled- and to his horror the ball skid through quick to disturb the furniture
lovely little late cut. It was full and just outside off, Uthappa crouched, opened the bat-face and unfurled a cute late cut. Watson has a few things to say at Uthappa
moves outside leg, he knew it was going to be a short one and just tapped it nonchalantly to wide third man
on the middle, clipped past square leg for a single
slightly short, on the off and middle and Uthappa goes for his pull shot but it wasn't so short and so, it went almost straight, just to the right of Watson and raced past the mid-on fielder
that slow bouncer again and it loops very high over Uthappa's head and bounces before it reaches the 'keeper
Here comes the expected bouncer, at the body, Takawale arched back, stayed beside the line and upper cut it to through vacant slip region
slow and short again, Uthappa waits before cutting it to wide third man
similar delivery but this time Uthappa hops to get on top of the bounce and works it to square leg for a single
slow bouncer - lots of bowlers have been using that in this tournament - Uthappa ducks
bouncer but it stops on the batsman who is early into his pull shot as a result and will pick up a single with a bottom edge to fine leg
fuller, on the middle and off, Uthappa shuffles across to work it to midwicket
slower one - it bounces a bit - tapped close on the off side, Robin calls Takewale for a quick single
cuts in off a length, on the middle, Uthappa tries to clip it to leg side, misses and it hits him high on the thigh pad.
fuller, just outside off stump, defended to the off side
bangs yet another bouncer Takawale goes for his pull and gets a top edge to fine leg boundary.
full and straight, Uthappa pushes it to covers for a single
bangs another one short and Jayasuriya pulls but finds the fielder at deep midwicket. Jayasuriya can't believe it even as the Royals celebrate.
Watto bowls a bouncer, sails over Jayasuriya's head
full and on the middle and off, defended back to the bowler
bouncer, chest-high, pulled to fine leg
That has been creamed through covers. Delicious. Full pitched outside off and put away easily
dabbed to third man
from wide of the crease, from round the stumps, a bouncer arrives and the batsman ducks
short delivery and Jayasuriya goes for a pull but as the ball stops on him a touch, he gets a inside edge to the pad
leans forward to defend yet another slower one to the off side
low full toss, pushed to left of mid-off for a single
yorker on the middle and off line, dug out to the off side
short and climbing outside off, cut to third man
moves outside leg, has a heave at a length delivery just outside leg, misses and the ball rushes past the leg stump. Again, Jayasuriya gets across to have a chat with the batsman
full and straight, Jayasuriya launches himself into it but he can only get a inside edge on to his pads. Enough, though, for a quick single
short of length, at the body, lapped to fine leg
bouncer, goes for the pull and misses
low dipping full toss, dabbed to covers
full again, slightly slower and lofted over mid-on
fullish, on the legs, he just picked it up over long leg. Just a flick. The boundaries are short there.
slower one, full, dabbed to the leg side
short of length, just outside off stump, cut to point
full, straight, tucked to right of mid-on for a single
length delivery on the middle and leg, tries to turn it to leg side, misses but will pick a leg bye.
Shot boss! It was slightly short in length and Jayasuriya short-arm jabbed it over midwicket. It just kept flying.
on a length, on the middle, straight and Jayasuriya pushes it back down the track
leans forward to drive to mid-off for a quick single. The throw misses the stumps and no one was backing up. Munaf is angry but there was a case for the throw. Just that, no one was backing
well outside the off stump, he has a jab, the bat hits the ground and the ball flies through to the 'keeper
on a length, on the off and middle, defended compactly to the off side
just outside off, dabbed to third man for a single
Tanvir goes round the stumps and sends one full outside off, Yogesh went for a slog but didn't connect. Jayasuriya walks across to have a chat
cuts in sharply and Jayasuriya is cramped but manages to nudge it to the off side
bangs it short, outside off and it comes in, Jayasuriya sways away
sends across a bouncer, ducked under.
short of length, climbing outside off, Yogesh inside edges the cut behind the stumps
short one and Yogesh pulls it - doesn't time it well - but it lands safely in deep midwicket region
goes for the bouncer, the batsman ducks and the ball slips a tad down leg side and a wide is called. Munaf is not too happy with the call. Warne shouts out words of encouragement
full and on the middle stump line, pushed to the off side
bouncer and fended away awkwardly to the off side. Risky single but Kaif fumbles
Full, outside off and Jayasuriya wanted to launch into in an orbit but failed to connect. Oohs and aahs from Warne
length delivery around the off stump, nudged to the off side. No runs of the bat in this over.
swing and a miss. In the zone outside off stump and he wanted to loft it over mid-on
goes for the bouncer but it was just down the leg side.
around that off stump, moving away, defended to the off side
swings down the leg side. Big wide. Tanvir, not Trivedi - we are changing it - tried to bring this one in but the release went awry
length delivery, again slanted across, steered to backward point
angles away across the batsman who shoulders arms
from over the wickets, on and around the off stump, defended to covers
